item.title: Made By AI :: [AI] Wolfenstein 3D for Sega Game Gear
item.description:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: [AI] Wolfenstein 3D for Sega Game Gear
Posted: Wed Nov 11, 2026 9:51 pm (GMT 0)



🔫 Wolfenstein 3D (Game Gear) --- Experimental v0.0.1 Port
----------------------------------------------------------

Building upon the existing Sega Master System codebase (`wolf-3d-sms`), this experimental *v0.0.1* release adapts the Wolfenstein 3D shareware episode for the Sega Game Gear using Arena.

Github repo: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/wolf-3d-gg
Itch.io page: https://haroldo-ok.itch.io/wolfenstein-3d-gg

🎮 Game Gear Adaptation & UI Changes
------------------------------------

*Display & Viewport:* repositioned the 160 × 96 raycasted 3D view squarely inside the Game Gear's smaller LCD screen area, paired with a newly designed, compact, and clearly labelled HUD.

*Hardware Integration:* Added support for Start-button input, native Game Gear palette writing, stereo sound routing, and an export-region ROM header.

*Menus & Screens Adapted:* Redesigned layout flows for difficulty selection, sound options, save slots, high scores, name entry, confirmation prompts, intermissions, and victory screens.

*Pannable High-Resolution Art:* Resized title screens and made help/ending pages pannable so players can view full-resolution graphics on the smaller portable screen.

*Tooling:* Created dedicated Game Gear build scripts and automated emulator test harnesses

item.title: Made By AI :: RE: [AI] Commander Keen 1 for Sega Master System
item.description:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: Commander Keen 1 for Sega Master System v0.0.9: Improve performance (60 FPS on most levels).
Posted: Wed Nov 11, 2026 9:43 pm (GMT 0)



Note: Levels 3 and 12 feature heavy enemy density packed into single areas, causing minor dips (~45–54 FPS) when every enemy is active on-screen simultaneously.
👾 Authentic Enemy AI & Mechanics

All classic entities and hazards have been ported state-for-state to match original DOS logic using exact hitboxes, timers, movement speeds, and probabilities:

Enemy Roster: Yorps, Gargs, Vorticons, Butler Robots, Tank Robots, and Ice Cannons match their original Commander Genus engine behavior.
Vorticon Hitboxes: Fixed to match the exact $24 \times 32$ pixel sprite bounds.
Ice Cannon Hazard: Ice chunks freeze Keen in a sliding ice block until a ray thaws him.
Level 16 Chandelier Rope: Shooting the rope drops the heavy stone block 4 rows with an authentic screen shake.
Walk-Behind Door Cut: Added pixel-exact doorway slicing when Keen steps into exit doors.
PAL Console Support: Automatically detects 50 Hz PAL consoles via VDP timing to maintain proper logic speed (6 ticks per 5 frames).

🛠️ Engine & Compiler Optimizations

Spatial Enemy Culling: The engine now restricts active AI updates to a tight box around the active camera view, avoiding waste on far-off enemies.
Z80 Assembly Hot Paths: Re-engineered tile collision checks (down from 650 to 190 CPU cycles), sprite composition, animated tile updates, and distance checks directly in Z80 assembly.
Lazy Checking: Item pickup collision only triggers when Keen enters a new tile cell, and wall checks only execute when moving into new tile columns.
Smoother Camera Cap: Implemented an 8-pixel per-frame camera movement speed ceiling to avoid background tile tearing during sudden teleportation jumps.
Banked Memory Architecture: Expanded the ROM layout to 432 KB across dedicated data banks, moving enemy routines, projectile logic, fonts, and Vorticon art out of the main bank to resolve previous memory overflows and boot crashes

Haroldo Pinheiro

Jill of the Jungle (Sega Master System) — v0.0.6 & v0.0.7 Release Notes

Itch.io page: https://haroldo-ok.itch.io/jill-...
Github repo: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/ji...

---

🤸‍♀️ v0.0.6: Movement Precision & Shaft Navigation

The *v0.0.6* update resolves frustrating platforming hurdles by fixing sprite animation direction bugs, narrowing collision hitboxes, and introducing smart corner-nudging and edge-drop assistance.

*Key Fixes & Improvements*

*Jump & Crouch Animation Fix:* Corrected inverted frame-direction mappings. Jump frames (`32–34` left, `40–42` right) and crouch frames (`37` and `45`) now properly match the direction Jill is facing.
*Forgiving Shaft Navigation:* Jill’s physical collision box was inset from a full 16-pixel sprite width down to **12 pixels**, providing ~5 pixels of extra slack when entering one-tile vertical shafts at running speed.
*Upward Corner Nudge:* If Jill's head catches a ceiling corner or ledge edge by up to 5 pixels while jumping upward, she automatically slides into the opening instead of hitting a dead stop.
*Immediate Edge-Drop & Down-Assist:* Jill now begins falling immediately the moment she steps off a solid edge. Additionally, holding *DOWN* next to a floor hole gently nudges and slides her into drops positioned within ~6 pixels of the edge.

---

🧱 v0.0.7: Missing Level Geometry Restored

The *v0.0.7* update fixes missing platforms, stepping stones, and environmental obstacles across multiple maps, aligning the port precisely with the original DOS game layouts.

*The Bug & The Fix*

*The Root Cause:* A converter rule had mistakenly flagged small groups of floating grey castle blocks as hidden AI monster "turn-around" markers, rendering them invisible and non-solid. In reality, these are physical *stepping stones* intended for the player to jump on.
*The Fix:* The faulty marker rule was removed, ensuring every map cell now renders and behaves exactly like the original game data.
